test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 8th November 2021)
subject: general
question: What inspired Rajamony to write his new book ‘India and the Netherlands: Past, Present and Future’?

options.text: The rule of the Dutch East India Company over Malabar in the 17th century.
His being the ambassador of India to the Netherlands.
Instances of the Indo-Dutch artistic and cultural exchange through the last 400 years.
The fact that ‘Hortus Malabaricus’ remained lost to the world for almost three centuries.

solution:
The correct answer is **'****Instances of the Indo-Dutch artistic and cultural exchange through the last 400 years.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's have a look at the third sentence of the second paragraph of the passage: 

 
 
• *'*Highlighting such instances of the Indo-Dutch artistic and cultural exchange through the last 400 years was the prime reason why Rajamony, who has been the Ambassador of India to the Netherlands, thought of writing this book. The book was released on 30 September 2019.*'*
 
• *​*It can be concluded from the above lines that* *instances of the Indo-Dutch artistic and cultural exchange through the last 400 years inspired Rajamony to write his new book ‘India and the Netherlands: Past, Present and Future’. (यह निष्कर्ष निकाला जा सकता है कि उपरोक्त पंक्ति से यह निष्कर्ष निकाला जा सकता है कि पिछले 400 वर्षों के दौरान भारत-डच कलात्मक और सांस्कृतिक आदान-प्रदान के उदाहरणों ने राजामोनी को अपनी नई पुस्तक 'इंडिया एंड द नीदरलैंड्स: पास्ट, प्रेजेंट एंड फ्यूचर' लिखने के लिए प्रेरित किया।).
 
 
 
• *​ *Hence, the correct answer is 'Instances of the Indo-Dutch artistic and cultural exchange through the last 400 years.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 

 

 
• The meaning of word 'instances' is* *a particular situation, event, or fact, especially an example of something that happens generally. ('Instances' शब्द का अर्थ एक विशेष स्थिति, घटना या तथ्य है, विशेष रूप से किसी ऐसी चीज का उदाहरण जो आम तौर पर होती है।).

 
 
• Example:* There have been several** instances **of violence at the school.*
